A small rectangular picture-in-picture window at the top right displays another man in a black shirt and loose pants standing outdoors at night on a paved walkway near tall city buildings. (2) The main subject begins practicing a complex sliding footwork dance, mimicking the instructor in the overlay. Numerical step indicators from Step 1 to Step 8 appear sequentially at the top center of the screen. The man focuses on his bare feet, lifting his knees and sliding across the floor. His expression is concentrated, then becomes more relaxed as he gains rhythm. (3) A large teal and yellow text overlay reading "成果驗收" appears in the center-bottom of the frame. The man performs the full dance sequence with higher energy, swinging his arms and moving dynamically across the living room space near a tan bean bag chair. The lighting remains bright and even, highlighting his body posture. (4) Towards the end of the sequence, the subject loses his footing slightly, causing him to break his dance posture. He laughs and smiles sheepishly at the camera, gesturing with his hands. The text "算了啦" appears at the bottom as he stops moving and the clip ends.
